sectionTitle: Targeted Programs for Medical & Engineering Aspirants
sectionSubtitle: Comprehensive curriculum, rigorous problem solving, and personalized guidance for every stage of your academic journey.

programs.name: NEET Repeater / Dropper Batch
programs.description: Exhaustive full-syllabus revision, rigorous daily problem-solving sessions, and weekly full-length OMR mock tests designed to maximize score in NEET-UG.
highlights: Complete 11th & 12th Physics, Chemistry, and Biology mastery
Over 10,000+ high-yield NEET practice questions
Weekly simulated OMR exams with rank and error analysis
Dedicated doubt cell with 1-on-1 faculty interaction
Access to quiet Reading Room & Library facility

programs.name: NEET Fresher (11th & 12th Integrated)
programs.description: Dual focus on Maharashtra State Board / CBSE syllabus along with deep conceptual fundamentals and speed-building techniques for NEET-UG.
highlights: Synchronized preparation for Board Exams and NEET-UG
Concept-first pedagogy with strong foundation in numericals
Periodic chapter-wise and cumulative mock tests
Regular parent-teacher feedback meetings and progress reports
Specialized sessions for tricky Organic and Mechanics concepts
programs.eligibility: Students moving to Class 11th or Class 12th

programs.name: Post-NEET Admission & Choice-Filling Counseling
programs.description: Exclusive one-on-one medical college admission counseling by Ansari Rehan Ahmed for students and parents. Complete rank analysis, preference form choice-filling, and round-by-round strategy.
highlights: Comprehensive Score & Rank evaluation for AIQ (15%) and Maharashtra State (85%) Quota
Strategic step-by-step preference & choice filling for MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS & Allied Sciences
Category-wise cutoff prediction and Government vs. Private college optimization
Complete roadmap for CAP Rounds (Round 1, 2, 3 & Mop-Up / Stray Vacancy rounds)
In-person dedicated consultation with student and parents by prior appointment
programs.eligibility: NEET-UG Qualified candidates and their parents (By Appointment)

programs.name: Pre-Foundation (Class 5th to 10th)
programs.description: Build solid mathematical intuition, scientific reasoning, and analytical thinking early to prepare students for future competitive exams (NEET, JEE, Olympiads, NTSE).
highlights: Core focus on Mathematics and Science fundamentals
Logical reasoning and mental ability development
School syllabus excellence + advanced competitive edge
Fun, interactive concept-building methodology
Small batch sizes ensuring personal attention for every student

programs.name: MHT-CET & JEE Foundation
programs.description: Specialized coaching for Maharashtra Common Entrance Test (MHT-CET) and IIT-JEE Main with targeted speed-accuracy drills and formula revision.
highlights: In-depth coverage of Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics
MHT-CET speed-testing shortcuts and time-management tips
JEE Main level problem-solving workshops
Mock tests mapped to the latest CET and JEE difficulty patterns
Continuous interaction with subject matter experts
programs.eligibility: 11th, 12th & Dropper students aiming for CET / JEE
